name: HEDISCoreMeta
title: HEDIS Core Meta
description: A data type profile on Meta to capture the HEDIS data source.
purpose: Data sources in HEDIS are required to be distinguished specifically between Administrative and Supplemental Data. This profile defines a set of codes that implementers must use to define the type of data source.
